rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command
rules.description: Detects base64-encoded PowerShell launched from an Office process.
rules.author: Vigil SOC community
rules.sigma:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command
id: 9d1b0d02-1f0a-4f21-9d1a-0f0a1b2c3d4e
status: stable
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-enc'
  condition: selection
level: high
rules.splunk: index=windows EventCode=1 Image="*\\powershell.exe" CommandLine="*-enc*" | stats count by host, User, CommandLine
rules.elastic: process where event.type == "start" and process.name : "powershell.exe" and process.command_line : "*-enc*"
rules.kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "-enc" | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

rules.title: Shadow Copy Deletion via vssadmin
rules.description: vssadmin delete shadows — a hallmark of ransomware pre-encryption.
rules.author: Vigil SOC community
rules.sigma:
title: Shadow Copy Deletion via vssadmin
id: 2c4a1b33-7e55-4a9c-8f11-5b6c7d8e9f00
status: stable
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
level: critical
rules.kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows")

rules.title: LSASS Memory Access
rules.description: Credential dumping via direct access to the LSASS process memory.
rules.author: Vigil SOC community
rules.sigma:
title: LSASS Memory Access
id: 7f3c9a11-2b44-4d66-9c88-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
logsource:
  category: process_access
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetImage|endswith: '\lsass.exe'
    GrantedAccess: '0x1410'
  condition: selection
level: high

cases.title: Suspected ransomware staging on FS-PROD-02
cases.summary: Auto-Response agent correlated encoded PowerShell, LSASS access and shadow-copy deletion on one host within 9 minutes. Confidence 0.94 — host isolated automatically.

cases.title: Impossible travel sign-in for j.doe
cases.summary: Investigator agent traced two successful sign-ins 6,400 km apart in 40 minutes. Confidence 0.71 — routed to a human analyst (below the 0.90 auto-containment threshold).
